rules.text: Shared roost work teaches companionship before command. Hunters provide for nesting gryphons, and a gryphon's care and deeds belong to clan life alongside those of dwarven companions. The wider community sustains these bonds even when its members do not ride.
rules.rationale: Approved finding G02. A retained Wildhammer gryphon-care practice plus an actually adopted relevant hunting or kinship custom; resolve one combined meaning if both qualify. Do not require Falconry for all gryphon custom. Keep care for companions separate from a particular person's ownership, birth-year group, marriage or present hunt. Preserve the practice through unrelated reforms and renaming.

rules.text: A clever improvement in metal or machinery earns regard through the advantage it delivers. The maker's demanding standard can outlast loyalty to the patron who ordered the work; skill, resentment and pride need not share an allegiance.
rules.rationale: Approved finding G04. The exact adopted craft plus a retained Dark Iron forge practice. Metal Craftsmanship has a current source-seed witness; Sorcerous Metallurgy is a later-adoption case. Reuse existing variants where sufficient. Do not infer Ragnaros worship, forced service, a named forge, magical skill or an individual grievance from cultural craft.

rules.text: Good hunting attends to the companion who notices another part of the trail. Freely offered service has value that an elaborate honor or commanding voice cannot buy; avoiding a needless fight can show better judgment than proving strength.
rules.rationale: Approved finding G05. Actual Hunters plus an authoritative retained Mok'nathal companionship practice; do not select the variant for all Orcish heritage. Do not require a friendship tradition the source culture does not have, assign a pet, or make reserve a compulsory personal disposition.

rules.text: Wolf tending belongs to the household's shared responsibilities. Knowing a companion's needs and temperament, keeping it fed and listening to its warning give loyalty a practical meaning beyond obedience or a rider's boast.
rules.rationale: Approved finding G03. Retained Frostwolf wolf partnership combined with an adopted relevant kinship or animal-care custom; keep independent pastoral husbandry intact. Do not replace all herds with wolves, turn every orc into a wolf rider, or introduce a living animal from ancestry alone. Existing hunting variants remain useful for later actual adoption.

rules.text: A chamber, instrument or silk record preserves another person's work as well as its present use. Keeping a contribution attributed, recording a warning and improving a predecessor's pattern sustain civic memory; a clever revision need not erase its maker.
rules.rationale: Approved finding G06. A retained Nerubian civic/archival practice and an actually adopted relevant civic or learning custom. This is a proposed scoped interpretation, not an assertion that City Keepers' game effects create archives. Aqir heritage also includes distinct societies. Do not grant a Scourge history, occupation, archive, religion or communal consciousness to an individual. Existing legal/diplomatic/learning readings do not independently retain attribution of a predecessor's contribution; adopting them must not suppress this civic-memory clause.

rules.text: A personal candle is a tool, comfort and token of dependable company. Borrowing it calls for permission and a plan for its return; contributing wax or useful salvage helps another person trust the newcomer sharing the shelter.
rules.rationale: Approved finding G10. Retained warren candle-care practice in a relevant mining, borrowing or hospitality context. Review whether a short mining refinement or topic-selected local custom is the better route. Do not infer candle worship, religious sacrifice, ownership of a candle or the location of the current scene from Murine heritage. Do not append this passage to every mining discussion.
